exposure: Type of labour induction drug (misoprostol vs. dinoprostone)
Implementation of Maternal and Perinatal Death Surveillance and Response (MPDSR) activities
cohort: The study participants were women who gave birth at Kiambu Level 5 Hospital between January 2018 and December 2020, specifically those who underwent labour induction.
finding: The switch from misoprostol to dinoprostone for labour induction was associated with a lower risk of maternal and perinatal death, but an increased risk of uterine rupture, while the period following MPDSR implementation was associated with an increased risk of death.
